tasks.title: Create offload skill and register in model-tiers.json
tasks.description: Create claude-code-shared/skills/offload/SKILL.md with full skill instructions. The skill accepts two inputs: (1) target skill name, (2) input content — either passed as an arg or compressed from the local conversation context before spawning. The skill looks up model and effort for the target skill from model-tiers.json, spawns Agent with isolation: 'remote' and the resolved model param, and includes a prompt template that instructs the remote agent to run the target skill at the looked-up effort level and return the full output file content as text. The local session receives that text and writes it to docs/seeds/ (for seeds) or docs/tasks/ (for tasks). Add 'offload': 'T2' to the skills section of model-tiers.json. Run scripts/sync-model-tiers.py --apply to propagate the tier to SKILL.md frontmatter.
acceptance_criteria: claude-code-shared/skills/offload/SKILL.md exists with name, description, model (sonnet), effort (medium), invokedBy (human) frontmatter

SKILL.md instructions cover: target skill arg, input content arg, model-tiers.json lookup, Agent spawn with isolation: 'remote', remote prompt template with effort instruction, local file write to docs/seeds/ or docs/tasks/
offload is NOT added to the delegate array (delegate is for local Haiku only)
tasks.summary: Created claude-code-shared/skills/offload/SKILL.md with correct frontmatter (model: sonnet, effort: medium, invokedBy: human) and full skill instructions covering target-skill arg, input-content arg with compression fallback, model-tiers.json lookup, Agent spawn with isolation: 'remote', remote prompt template with effort instruction, and local file write routing; registered 'offload': 'T2' in model-tiers.json and confirmed sync-model-tiers.py --apply propagated correctly.

tasks.title: Live smoke test: invoke offload with to-seed on cloud VM
tasks.description: Invoke /offload to-seed with a short test input. Verify the remote agent executes on a cloud VM via isolation: 'remote', returns seed content as text, and the local session writes a valid JSON file to docs/seeds/. Cold VM startup of 30-60s is expected on first invocation. Observe that only the final result text appears in the local context window, not the remote agent's intermediate tool calls.
acceptance_criteria: Output seed file written to docs/seeds/ with valid JSON content
File contains expected seed fields: schema_version, title, decisions
Local context window contains only the final returned text, not remote intermediate work

tasks.title: Test whether /effort session propagation carries over to isolation: 'remote' agents
tasks.description:
Test whether /effort session propagation carries over to isolation: 'remote' agents.

If propagation works, the offload skill could drop the explicit effort instruction in the remote prompt and rely on session state instead. This is currently unverified; the v1 offload skill hardcodes effort via prompt text from model-tiers.json as a safe default.
